lead: A source path is read off the filesystem in more places than the front end, and the configuration snapshot is the one that bites.
body: A bundled executable resolves its entry and `require` graph out of an appended payload, so the path handed to `nvs run` is synthetic — and `nvs_config::Snapshot::build` canonicalizes that same path through `trust::canonical` to key `rule:config/an-application-is-its-entry-file-path`'s `[[app]]` blocks, refusing the run with `E0605` after the program compiled cleanly (`run_run` now substitutes the executable's own path, since a bundle is one trust domain). Before changing a byte source, `grep -n 'canonicalize\|read_to_string' crates/` for the other readers; only one of them is in `nvs-hir`.
